projects.title: Kalsuri
projects.description: Kalsuri is an AI platform for reporting road defects. Its mobile app is designed to take photographs of road defects, and through the use of computer vision, it can detect the type of road damage and report the defects to a central web application where defects can be prioritized and assigned to maintenance personnel.

projects.title: Package Manager App
projects.description: This was the final project for my Information Management class, which is a class that focused on working with SQL and databases. This project was developed using Django and presented a managerial view of a fictional delivery company that allowed its users to filter through the database using a dynamic SQL statement.

projects.title: Wordle Clone
projects.description: A wordle clone developed for the Year-End party (a project I headed) for Ateneo Gabay. We asked participants to solve a particular word (the event's theme) wordle-style.

projects.title: Wordle Streaks
projects.description: Extending on the current version of Wordle, this game, which was developed using CSS, HTML, and Javascript, essentially removes the one-day wait for a new Wordle word. Players can keep hitting the 'Next' button, allowing them to play Wordle for as long as they want. This game keeps the player's current streak.

projects.title: Ateneo Food Directory
projects.description: As part of the requirements for my Enterprise Systems Programming class, we were tasked to create a software application that demostrated our abilities to use SpringBoot. My group created Ateneo Food Directory, an one-stop-shop for an Atenean's cravings.

projects.title: AEGIS Website
projects.description: I worked on the front-end (and a bit of back-end bug fixing) of Ateneo AEGIS' (the official yearbook committee of the undergraduate students of the Loyola Schools) website.

projects.title: Bullet Journal App
projects.description: This bullet journal was my midterm project for my Software Development class. It was made using the Django framework. This is where I first experienced working with the magic of backend development.

projects.title: Student Assignment Manager
projects.description: This web app is designed to be a task distributor used by teachers in order to disseminate tasks to their students. A teacher can create a Questboard for a specific topic in the course, and assign the number of stars needed to get full marks on any particular quest. The teacher can then post quests in the Questboard where up to three students can call dibs and earn stars for the questboard.

projects.title: Ateneo Gabay Website
projects.description: As the Associate Secretary-General for Website Management of Ateneo Gabay, the Ateneo organization that advocates for quality education for Atenean scholars and public elementary school kids, I made the org's website.

projects.title: LIONS Website
projects.description: The League of Independent Organizations (LIONS) of the Ateneo needed a website for their recruitment phase. I was part of the two-man team that created this website for them.

projects.title: Verdant Agri Website
projects.description: As part of Ateneo education, students are challenged to become persons with and for others. We were tasked to help a target community in need of our set of skills and experiences. My group was designed and developed the website for Verdant Agriculture, a cooperative that seeks to help Overseas Filipino workers become more financially stable once they return to the Philippines.
